Rajasthan High Court Criticizes Hill Cutting for Hotels in Udaipur

The Rajasthan High Court has stated that hills in Udaipur are being "brutally cut" to make way for hotels, describing the city's condition as "pitiable." The court noted that policies regarding this development were framed by private agencies. This observation came during a hearing concerning the environmental degradation in the region.
